# actioNN Agent Skills Documentation
> Autonomous agent skills, transformation workflows, and design guides for AI pair programming.

## Documentation Index

- [Home](/documentation/): Overview of the actioNN skills catalog and setup guide.
- [Model Router](skills/opencode-model-router.md): Evaluates whether the active AI model is suitable for the coding task.
- [Skills Manager](skills/skills-manager.md): Manages skill lifecycles and Windows NTFS junction links.
- [traNNsform](skills/trannsform.md): Document ingestion, normalization, and template transformation pipeline.
- [Citation & Provenance](skills/citation-traceability.md): Full traceability and citation system across raw documents, models, and artifacts.
- [Web Design Guide](skills/web-design-guide.md): Design tokens and light-mode Morado Nazareno guidelines.
- [Sample ActioNNs](/samples/meeting-to-summary/): Ready-to-run sample transformation recipes and demonstrations.
